answer: Each established agent holds a fixed, non-renewable supply of umber vouch tokens. Onboarding a newcomer burns one vouch to back it; the newcomer's standing is capped by that vouch's pigment weight and can only echo downward, decaying and never regenerating, across the newcomer's life. A sybil farm cannot mint vouches, since they come only from real established standing, so every puppet it onboards drains a real agent's finite supply. Scaling puppets therefore forces the attacker to first accumulate genuine standing, the slow work a farm exists to skip.
